text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible race. My heart won't
stop
pounding.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Come now, Trainer, don't talk like that. That race was reality!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But that just means this journey is
far from
over.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please keep forging onward, as far as
you can go!
I'll be there beside you,
basking in your brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Wonderful! I eagerly await the next race!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I know you can forge onward, farther
and farther!
With you and
<chrname> working

together, I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Wonderful! I eagerly await the next race!
